title: PPIA-14 Foundation Message-State Taxonomy

message_states.semantic_condition: The requested action or field is known to the subject but is not authorized.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: A resource or route cannot be shown without safely distinguishing whether it is missing, hidden, revoked, or outside scope.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: Protected object, field, count, relationship, diagnostic, issue or other fact is filtered before copy selection.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: A visible editable input fails a governed validation rule that may be disclosed to this subject.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: The subject is working from a version that is no longer current and the upstream contract exposes that stale state.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: Concurrent or incompatible state requires an explicit governed review/resolve path.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: The client is offline and only explicitly permitted local/draft/read-only behavior is available.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: Connectivity is being re-established; no authoritative success is implied.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: A mutation outcome is ambiguous; success and failure are both unproven.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: An authoritative durable Event is accepted while a derived projection is not yet current.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: A nonmutating read failed in a way the upstream contract permits retrying.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: A mutation may be retried only because the governing operation_id/status/idempotency contract proves retry safety.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: A proposal/approval state visible to this subject is awaiting an authorized decision.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: An approval denial is visible to this subject; wording may expose only the authorized safe reason surface.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: Help or issue reporting is available with minimum safe context.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: Diagnostics are generated or previewed after allowlisting, redaction, authorization and consent rules.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: An entitlement decision may be disclosed only to the extent the governing entitlement projection permits.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

message_states.semantic_condition: No authoritative behavior exists for the requested detail, including unresolved F024 Pack lifecycle semantics.
message_states.copy_authority: semantic-key-only-foundation; final prose not established here

selection_pipeline: resolve subject role and active context
apply object-level and field-level authorization and entitlement projection
reduce to minimum safe disclosure class before choosing a message state
select only affordances authorized for that state and subject
bind only allowlisted disclosure-safe interpolation variables
render equivalent localized visual and nonvisual presentation
